# MEM-111 plan — generated file preview

- [x] **Spreadsheet route.** `ChatFileArtifactController` `GET /{id}/preview`; `SpreadsheetPreview` in `chat.interpreter` with POI `XSSFReader`, CSV quoting, the 500 000-character row-boundary cut; OpenAPI and generated client.
- [x] **Preview panel.** Variant resolver in the Onyx order; image, pdf (`DocumentPdfView`), csv, xlsx tabs, markdown, docx (`docx-preview` + DOMPurify), text/code/json, unsupported.
- [x] **Card entry point.** The file name opens the side panel; download remains.
- [x] **Onyx modal (owner decision 2026-09-17).** Centered `ChatFilePreviewModal` sized by variant with header description, floating footer (counts, zoom, copy, download), spinner and download-on-error; opened from cards, answer file links and attachment chips; `GET /api/chat/files/{id}/preview` for xlsx attachments. Evidence: `chat-file-reader.test.tsx`, `chat-answer-links.test.tsx`, `chat-code.test.tsx`, e2e `chat-generated-file-preview.spec.ts`, screenshots reviewed in desktop light/dark and mobile.
- [x] **Tests.** (`SpreadsheetPreviewTest`, `chat-file-preview.test.ts`, `chat-code.test.tsx`) Java: CSV quoting, row-boundary cut, sheet order and names, non-xlsx rejected, owner-only. Web: variant resolution, csv parser with quoted commas and newlines, docx sanitizer drops `javascript:` and keeps `data:` images, the panel opens from the card.
- [x] **Docs.** Chat spec generated-files section and verification matrix.
- [x] **pptx.** Impress measured at +28.1 MB on trixie; `pptx-to-pdf` in the executor; `PresentationPreviewService` converts on first preview and caches the PDF (V73); the modal shows it in the pdf reader. Evidence: `PresentationPreviewServiceTest`, `ChatPersistenceIntegrationTest.interpreterSettingRevisesAndGeneratedFilesServeOnlyTheirOwner`, `test_office_stack.py::test_pptx_to_pdf_converts_a_vietnamese_deck_and_refuses_other_files` (CI), e2e pptx screenshot.
- [ ] **Evidence.** Local tests; a staging preview of a Vietnamese xlsx, docx and pdf generated by `run_python`.
